cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

#
# This file is generated only once,
# and is not re-generated if converter is called multiple times.
#
# User is free to modify the file as much as necessary
#

# Setup compiler settings
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)


# Define the build type
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Debug")
endif()

# Set the project name
set(CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME Handsome_Car)

# Enable compile command to ease indexing with e.g. clangd
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS TRUE)

# Core project settings
project(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})
message("Build type: " ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE})

# Enable CMake support for C, C++ and ASM languages
enable_language(C CXX ASM)

# Create an executable object type
add_executable(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})

# YXN_ECF contains C++ sources. Keep all user C++ code on C++17.
target_compile_features(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE cxx_std_17)

# Add STM32CubeMX generated sources
add_subdirectory(cmake/stm32cubemx)

# Add project-owned modules and FreeRTOS task overrides. All source files are
# selected explicitly in Usercode/CMakeLists.txt; no recursive source scan is
# used here.
add_subdirectory(Usercode)

# ============================================================
# YXN_ECF common library
# ============================================================

# YXN_ECF source root used by the explicit source and include lists below.
# CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR here is the Handsome_Car project root.
set(YXN_ECF_DIR
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/YXN_ECF"
)

# YXN_ECF usage:
# 1. Add the required .c/.cpp file to target_sources() below.
# 2. Add the directory containing its header to
#    target_include_directories() below.
# 3. Do not use GLOB to collect the whole directory automatically. Explicit
#    paths make MCU/peripheral compatibility visible during review.

# Link directories setup
target_link_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined library search paths
)

# Add sources to executable
target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user sources here

    # Hardware-independent algorithms
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/algorithm/FeedForward/FeedForward.cpp
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/algorithm/LowPassFilter/LowPassFilter.cpp
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/algorithm/MahonyAHRS/MahonyAHRS.c
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/algorithm/MyMath/MyMath.c
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/algorithm/PID/PID.cpp
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/algorithm/SlopePlaning/SlopePlaning.cpp

    # STM32F407 uses bxCAN. Do not add the H7 FDCAN implementation here.
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/CAN/bxCAN/bsp_can.c
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/CAN/bxCAN/bxcan_adapter.cpp

    # BSP modules supported by the peripherals currently generated by CubeMX
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/DWT/DWT.c
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/Encoder/bsp_encoder.cpp

    # Modules used with the enabled GPIO/bxCAN support
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/module/Key/key.cpp
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/module/Relay/Relay.cpp
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/module/RM_Module/DJI_Motor/DJI_Motor.cpp

    # Example: enable these only after CubeMX has generated the corresponding
    # peripheral source, HAL driver and handle.
    # ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/PWM/bsp_pwm.cpp
    # ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/SPI/bsp_spi.cpp
    # ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/I2C/bsp_i2c.cpp
    # ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/USART/bsp_usart.cpp
    # ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/module/bmi088/bmi088.cpp
    # ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/module/WS2812/WS2812.cpp
)

# Add include paths
target_include_directories(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined include paths

    # Algorithms
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/algorithm/FeedForward
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/algorithm/LowPassFilter
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/algorithm/MahonyAHRS
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/algorithm/MyMath
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/algorithm/PID
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/algorithm/SlopePlaning

    # bxCAN and BSP
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/CAN
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/CAN/bxCAN
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/DWT
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/Encoder

    # Modules
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/module/Key
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/module/Relay
    ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/module/RM_Module/DJI_Motor

    # Header paths matching the optional examples above:
    # ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/PWM
    # ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/SPI
    # ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/I2C
    # ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/bsp/USART
    # ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/module/bmi088
    # ${YXN_ECF_DIR}/module/WS2812
)

# Add project symbols (macros)
target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    # Add user defined symbols
)

# Remove wrong libob.a library dependency when using cpp files
list(REMOVE_ITEM CMAKE_C_IMPLICIT_LINK_LIBRARIES ob)

# Add linked libraries
target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}
    stm32cubemx

    # Add user defined libraries
)
